name: Minato Kageaki
source:
A young man secretly working under orders from the prince to subjugate the Silver Star. His Tsurugi is Muramasa. While on a mission, he introduces himself as a policeman working part-time for the Kamakura Police Department. [spoiler] Under normal circumstances, he spends his days in his cell at the Kamakura Detention House as an unconvicted prisoner due to committing a variety of crimes, including matricide.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Full_Metal_Daemon:_Muramasa]Wikipedia[/url]]
